description.value: Founded in 1930, West Point Cycles is British Columbia's oldest bicycle retailer, still family owned and operated nearly a century later. The Kerrisdale location sits conveniently right off the Arbutus Greenway and stocks a full range of bikes, parts, apparel, and accessories. The on-site service department handles everything from basic tune-ups to e-bike and cargo bike repairs, making it a strong stop for touring cyclists needing professional support.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 17m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and provides strong primary evidence. The Kerrisdale location page confirms address (6069 West Boulevard, Vancouver, BC V6M 3X2) and phone (604-263-7587). The service subpage explicitly describes walk-in estimates and tiered repair packages including dedicated e-bike service, confirming mechanical support; no explicit mention of pumps, washrooms, rentals, or DIY stands was found.
concerns: OSM record has no osm_id and empty osm_tags — this entry appears to originate from manual addition rather than an OSM node; phone and address could not be cross-checked against OSM (none present in record).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, long-established (est. 1930), publicly accessible bike shop on the Arbutus Greenway corridor with confirmed service capabilities including e-bike repair. Clearly valuable to touring cyclists.
